reference_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: HajiSaki personal companion app character reference sheet, the master identity lock for all later illustrations. Draw Togawa Sakiko (丰川祥子) from BanG Dream!/Ave Mujica: long ice-blue hair with her characteristic two low blue side tails and clean straight bangs, pale grey-blue eyes, refined aristocratic face, dignified reserved demeanor with a gentle private warmth. One consistent character in a front head-and-shoulders portrait, three-quarter head-and-shoulders portrait, side profile, and full-body outfit view, arranged cleanly on a single landscape character sheet. Fully clothed dark Prussian-blue high-collar gothic piano dress with restrained antique champagne-gold embroidery and white shirt collar, tiny rose and crescent details. Cel-shaded anime mixed with refined painterly texture; precise elegant facial proportions, controlled moonlight highlights. Color palette #05070F #0B1021 #8CB4F5 #B5CEFA #D4AF67 #EDF1FA. Flat very light cool grey sheet background to show silhouettes. No title, labels, logos, watermark or extra people. Keep face, hair and outfit absolutely consistent in all views. Sharp high-resolution production concept art, not a screenshot or UI.
